question: Among female superheroes published by Marvel Comics, find the one with the highest durability attribute and return her full name along with her height rank among all Marvel female heroes.

prediction.sql:
WITH MarvelFemaleHeroes AS (
    SELECT 
        s.XCL_018 AS hero_id,
        s.XCL_020 AS full_name,
        s.XCL_028 AS height
    FROM superhero s
    INNER JOIN gender g ON s.XCL_021 = g.XCL_007
    INNER JOIN publisher p ON s.XCL_026 = p.XCL_014
    WHERE g.XCL_008 = 'Female'
      AND p.XCL_015 = 'Marvel Comics'
),
RankedHeroes AS (
    SELECT 
        hero_id,
        full_name,
        height,
        RANK() OVER (ORDER BY height DESC) AS height_rank
    FROM MarvelFemaleHeroes
),
TopDurability AS (
    SELECT 
        s.XCL_018 AS hero_id
    FROM superhero s
    INNER JOIN gender g ON s.XCL_021 = g.XCL_007
    INNER JOIN publisher p ON s.XCL_026 = p.XCL_014
    INNER JOIN hero_attribute ha ON s.XCL_018 = ha.XCL_009
    INNER JOIN attribute a ON ha.XCL_010 = a.XCL_003
    WHERE g.XCL_008 = 'Female'
      AND p.XCL_015 = 'Marvel Comics'
      AND a.XCL_004 = 'Durability'
    ORDER BY ha.XCL_011 DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT 
    rh.full_name,
    rh.height_rank
FROM TopDurability td
INNER JOIN RankedHeroes rh ON td.hero_id = rh.hero_id

compiled_semantic_plan.candidate_sql:
WITH MarvelFemaleHeroes AS (
    SELECT 
        s.XCL_018 AS hero_id,
        s.XCL_020 AS full_name,
        s.XCL_028 AS height
    FROM superhero s
    INNER JOIN gender g ON s.XCL_021 = g.XCL_007
    INNER JOIN publisher p ON s.XCL_026 = p.XCL_014
    WHERE g.XCL_008 = 'Female'
      AND p.XCL_015 = 'Marvel Comics'
),
RankedHeroes AS (
    SELECT 
        hero_id,
        full_name,
        height,
        RANK() OVER (ORDER BY height DESC) AS height_rank
    FROM MarvelFemaleHeroes
),
TopDurability AS (
    SELECT 
        s.XCL_018 AS hero_id
    FROM superhero s
    INNER JOIN gender g ON s.XCL_021 = g.XCL_007
    INNER JOIN publisher p ON s.XCL_026 = p.XCL_014
    INNER JOIN hero_attribute ha ON s.XCL_018 = ha.XCL_009
    INNER JOIN attribute a ON ha.XCL_010 = a.XCL_003
    WHERE g.XCL_008 = 'Female'
      AND p.XCL_015 = 'Marvel Comics'
      AND a.XCL_004 = 'Durability'
    ORDER BY ha.XCL_011 DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT 
    rh.full_name,
    rh.height_rank
FROM TopDurability td
INNER JOIN RankedHeroes rh ON td.hero_id = rh.hero_id

WITH MarvelFemaleHeroes AS (
    SELECT 
        s.XCL_018 AS hero_id,
        s.XCL_020 AS full_name,
        s.XCL_028 AS height
    FROM superhero s
    INNER JOIN gender g ON s.XCL_021 = g.XCL_007
    INNER JOIN publisher p ON s.XCL_026 = p.XCL_014
    WHERE g.XCL_008 = 'Female'
      AND p.XCL_015 = 'Marvel Comics'
),
RankedHeroes AS (
    SELECT 
        hero_id,
        full_name,
        height,
        RANK() OVER (ORDER BY height DESC) AS height_rank
    FROM MarvelFemaleHeroes
),
TopDurability AS (
    SELECT 
        s.XCL_018 AS hero_id
    FROM superhero s
    INNER JOIN gender g ON s.XCL_021 = g.XCL_007
    INNER JOIN publisher p ON s.XCL_026 = p.XCL_014
    INNER JOIN hero_attribute ha ON s.XCL_018 = ha.XCL_009
    INNER JOIN attribute a ON ha.XCL_010 = a.XCL_003
    WHERE g.XCL_008 = 'Female'
      AND p.XCL_015 = 'Marvel Comics'
      AND a.XCL_004 = 'Durability'
    ORDER BY ha.XCL_011 DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT 
    rh.full_name,
    rh.height_rank
FROM TopDurability td
INNER JOIN RankedHeroes rh ON td.hero_id = rh.hero_id

WITH MarvelFemaleHeroes AS (
    SELECT 
        s.XCL_018 AS hero_id,
        s.XCL_020 AS full_name,
        s.XCL_028 AS height,
        ha.XCL_011 AS durability_value
    FROM superhero s
    INNER JOIN gender g ON s.XCL_021 = g.XCL_007
    INNER JOIN publisher p ON s.XCL_026 = p.XCL_014
    INNER JOIN hero_attribute ha ON s.XCL_018 = ha.XCL_009
    INNER JOIN attribute a ON ha.XCL_010 = a.XCL_003
    WHERE g.XCL_008 = 'Female'
      AND p.XCL_015 = 'Marvel Comics'
      AND a.XCL_004 = 'Durability'
),
RankedHeroes AS (
    SELECT 
        hero_id,
        full_name,
        height,
        durability_value,
        RANK() OVER (ORDER BY height DESC) AS height_rank
    FROM MarvelFemaleHeroes
)
SELECT 
    full_name,
    height_rank
FROM RankedHeroes
ORDER BY durability_value DESC
LIMIT 1
